title: 02 · 금속 명패형
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied Rune Nexus actual battle screenshot into a NEW alternative IN-BATTLE GLOBAL UPGRADE TAB concept. First reference is edit target; references 2/3/4 are exact existing icons for 포탑 화력 / 처치 보너스 / 정비 보급 respectively.
Preserve portrait composition, top HUD and resources, stone/grass isometric battlefield, purple portal, cyan core, charcoal teal background and existing speed/manual/start controls. Upgrade dock is integrated edge-to-edge at bottom, above footer. Keep the core and battlefield visible. May use unused lower field to fit new dock; do not redesign terrain or upper HUD.
Keep CURRENT game theme: near-black navy, subdued teal, slim beveled dark silver metal, tiny clipped corners, restrained gold currency and selected rim; white readable Korean text, quiet grey descriptions, cyan NEXT values. Not a web dashboard, no rounded SaaS cards, no huge ornamental fantasy frames, no neon overload.
THIS IS NOT a main menu, permanent upgrade screen, or individual turret level-up. No hero tower, tower sales/traits, modal, tabs for combat/economy, new upgrade type, new feature, confirm step, bulk buy, artificial progress bars.
Exact shared content: header '업그레이드' and small scope text '이번 전투에 적용'.
Exactly THREE upgrades, all purchasable with 3000 gold, each Lv.0/20.
1 '포탑 화력', description '모든 포탑 피해', current '+0%', next '+3%', purchase coin '32 G'.
2 '처치 보너스', description '적 처치 골드', current '+0%', next '+2%', purchase coin '20 G'.
3 '정비 보급', description '웨이브 종료 골드', current '+0 G', next '+4 G', purchase coin '10 G'.
Clearly show current→next and purchase meaning. Costs are each within their own button. Preserve icon identities from references.
Bottom footer order EXACTLY '포탑' | '업그레이드' | '젬'. Only center 업그레이드 selected. Keep small existing tab motifs. No additional close control or backdrop dimming.
Output ONE full portrait screenshot per request, crisp Korean type, no device frame, no commentary or titles outside screenshot. Concept only, not implemented.

VARIANT 02 — sculpted horizontal metal nameplates. Three equal slim horizontal rows stacked within one shared dock. Each row has an asymmetric clipped left edge and a subtle single bevel, not nested frames. Icon ~32 logical px at far left, name and tiny Lv.0/20 at upper middle, brief description below, effect comparison '+0% → +3%' at bottom middle. Right end is a connected deep-teal purchase area reading '구매' above gold coin + cost, visually part of the row yet clearly tappable. Use very thin gaps between nameplates, no large margins. Similar physical character to actual Start button, subtly machined and grounded. Active costs warm gold, next values cyan. Dock height around 205 logical px in 440x900 canvas. Distinguish from generic plain list by continuous metal nameplate silhouettes and integrated action ends, but don't overdecorate.
